race.description: The Doylo Lifestyle Group Springtime Conditional Hcp (Bm68)
race.comment: OLIVIA TWIST (7) made an encouraging return at Canterbury but couldn't quite follow it up at Warwick Farm last time. Blinkers go on first time and Lloyd takes over. Bold showing anticipated. SILENCIO PORFAVOR (3) dominated his rivals at Newcastle earlier in the prep over this trip and hasn't been far away since. Gets in well with the 3kg claim and only needs to hold his form to be there at the business end. GRINZINGER POD (4) has returned in good order and is sure to give herself every chance again from the inside alley. NOVA CENTAURI (9) was too good for her rivals when resuming at Scone. Is sure to have come on from that and should appreciate stretching out the extra 200m. LAST DRUID (2) just missed two back in town over this trip but got the bob last time at Hawkesbury. Steps back slightly in trip off a 47-day freshen and is among the winning chances.
